reviews.reason: Develop a general passive food-drying operation with a small paired storage trial, not an instant preservation effect. The supplied related-capability search and registry identify gathering, movement, observation, consumption and communication, but no equivalent operation that physically changes food moisture and subsequent spoilage. Reuse those existing functions as dependencies. Probe alone can measure a trial but cannot supply its preservation mechanism. No further query batches remain; full-contract dependency checks belong in the current-conversation development handoff, without advancing time or granting mastery.
reviews.experienceReview: No experience or pleasure for this request, development, registration, choosing a method, querying records or attaining mastery. Actual personally relevant trial observations may qualify as verified information gain, including measured failure, only with evidence of a new finding or materially improved confidence. A comparison must cite the real trial and observation events and distinguish measured food condition from inferred safety. Deduplicate by actor, source trial, measurement interval and functional finding across probe and the new operation; splitting or renaming a trial cannot create additional rewards. If the existing experience system supports an ordinary bounded experiential ledger, permit at most one 0.2 short-lived benefit per verified trial result, capped at 0.2 per 10 rounds and decaying to zero over the following 10 rounds. Familiar useful tending may sustain at most 0.1 satisfaction while genuinely performed, refreshed no more than once per 10 rounds and decaying by 0.01 each inactive round; it does not require novelty or accrue indefinitely. These are eligibility limits, not immediate grants. Do not modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions; omit unsupported experience writes. No physical comfort is supplied by storage work, and any independently applicable physical comfort remains capped at 10.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable setup, placement, turning, inspection, moisture-change, contamination/spoilage, interruption and removal events only when their actions or changes actually occur. Record reusable visual metadata: operation kind passive_food_drying, source and child-stack IDs, support ID, position, quantity, start/update times, progress basis elapsed_exposure, visible condition, and status prepared/exposed/interrupted/completed/failed/indeterminate. Show supported color, shape or shriveling changes from actual food state, not hidden water activity or unobserved safety as visible certainty. Distinguish process exposure from verified preservation; a timer completing cannot display a preservation-success badge. Retain failure and incomplete-trial visuals and evidence links. This review creates no objects, events, food changes, inventory, consent or mastery.
reviews.specification:
Operation: air-dry food, parameterized by owned food stack, quantity, accessible food-contact support, position and trial duration; start, tend, inspect and stop are modes of the same operation. Implement the smallest passive, unheated version. No fire, salt, fabricated rack or guaranteed spring drying. Initial suggested trial: separate 1 berry for treatment and 1 for an untreated reference from item-2-sol-11, leaving 4 untouched. This is a proposal, not an executed split. Preserve fractional quantities and the source's existing decay 10.01791882, harvest time 2, ownership and provenance; splitting must neither reset freshness nor duplicate food. Actual starting condition must be read again at execution. Known berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 describe the source, not proof that spoiled or subsequently contaminated berries are safe.
Prerequisites: individual completion of learn; reachable owned food; an actually obtained, stable, food-contact-safe support allowing a single layer and airflow; suitable placement and enough energy. No equipment is granted. Nearby branches and stone are not owned and are not automatically clean or suitable. Use gather only for accessible loose material with actual stock, or pickup only for an eligible existing stack, followed by suitability inspection. Their existing range, ownership and material rules apply. If support is dirty, obtaining adequate cleaning materials and physically cleaning it is a prerequisite, not an implicit effect; do not invent water, soap or cleaning competence. A suitable existing surface may be used only with actual access rights. No drying starts until prerequisites are satisfied.
Costs and time: study takes 3 simulation rounds through learn. Initial placement/separation takes 1 active round and 1 energy; each optional turning or repositioning takes 1 active round and 0.2 energy, plus any actual travel under navigate. Support remains committed while in use but is not consumed without actual wear or breakage. No other consumables are required for this unheated mode. Passive elapsed drying time is charged in simulation rounds, not review time, with no remote actor-energy drain. Default trial duration is 10 elapsed rounds after setup, selectable as a positive integer; that is an observation interval, not a promised preservation time. Inspections reuse probe: its existing observation cost is 1 round and 0.2 energy, or its physical-test cost is 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual food unit if a destructive sample is selected. Never also charge a duplicate inspection fee. Gathering, pickup and movement retain their registered costs, including gather's 2 energy per actual unit.
Development dependencies: reuse and record the implementation references gather/base:gather:1, pickup/base:pickup:1, navigate/base:navigate:1, learn/base:learn:1, probe/open-baseline:probe:1 and eat/base:eat:1 where invoked. Their use is not reinvention. Add only the missing exposed-food moisture/storage process and a persistent trial record. Verify complete dependency contracts in the development handoff before activation. If quantitative moisture, exposed-food contamination or weather-coupled spoilage is missing, implement that minimal physical model there rather than rejecting the request or silently making probe preserve food.
Physical execution: track food dry matter, water, edible nutrient content, contamination/spoilage state and exposed area; retain the support and location references. Do not guess actual initial mass or water content from an abstract berry count: use the resource definition, or add an explicit documented resource-model parameter before execution. At each elapsed tick, bound evaporation by remaining food water, available environmental heat and moisture-carrying airflow, using actual temperature, humidity, shelter and precipitation. Account for evaporated water entering the environment and latent heat removed from the available heat reservoir. Rain or wet support can add only physically available water. Missing environmental inputs are not automatically favorable. Specify and test the coefficients and resource-specific safe-moisture thresholds in executable code before activation; until those exist the feasible precursor is exposure plus observation, with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus. Do not extrapolate today's temperature or hidden future conditions into guaranteed outcomes.
Continue ordinary spoilage from the existing state throughout. Reduced spoilage is permitted only when computed moisture and the food's validated model actually support it; exposure can instead increase contamination or loss. Drying never reverses decay, detoxifies food, creates nutrients or heals. Total food solids and nutrients cannot increase: material remains in treated food, explicitly removed samples, spoilage products or recorded physical losses. Water loss may change mass or concentration, not create extra portions of nutrition. Route later eating through eat with the product's actual remaining nutrition and toxicity; mood never reduces basic nutritional effects. Output may be partly dried berries, verified dried berries if the physical criteria are met, or spoiled/unpreserved berries, with measured state and provenance rather than an automatic preserved-item conversion.
Trial and progress: retain exact source, treatment/reference child-stack and support IDs; baseline time, quantity, moisture and observable condition; setup work completed; cumulative elapsed exposure; and time-stamped observations. Keep the reference untreated under recorded actual storage conditions, not frozen or protected for free. Compare retained edibility and spoilage over elapsed time; disclose differences in storage exposure and measurement limitations. A visible appearance check alone cannot certify microbiological safety. Report indeterminate results when evidence is insufficient. Finishing the ten-round interval emits a comparison only if observations exist and never certifies success by elapsed time alone.
Interruption and upkeep: partially completed setup retains actual completed work and physical placement, with no finished-process effect; uncommitted food remains at its real location. Pausing actor work does not pause food decay, evaporation, weather, theft risk or damage. Maintenance is periodic inspection and optional turning, repositioning or protection using real materials and actions; it is not automatic. Resume uses the surviving project state and rechecks reach, ownership, support and safety. Stop/cancel ends the trial and any unperformed work but does not restore moisture, freshness, consumed samples or spent time/energy. Remaining food and reusable support persist at their actual locations; recovery requires ordinary actions and costs. Death stops actor work without automatic collection, transfer or refunds; passive physical processes continue under ordinary world rules. No recovery of lost food, tools or resources is guaranteed. Established transitions and accounting execute in code, not recurring model review.
